sample_unit: responses (20 questions, each answered by Google and ChatGPT-4)

links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading level of ChatGPT and Google responses to craniofacial patient questions
links.effect: Cleft palate: Google 9.95 vs ChatGPT 13.22 (P=0.006); craniosynostosis: 14.66 vs 14.73 (P=0.467). ChatGPT responses were at roughly grade 13-15 reading levels.
links.quote: For cleft palate queries, Google responses had significantly lower reading levels than ChatGPT (9.95 vs 13.22, P  = 0.006).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4 responses to common patient questions regarding craniofacial conditions compared to Google Search for readability, accuracy, and completeness without evaluating a specific deployment practice.
